 Celtics vs. Mavericks Game Info
 Date: Sunday, November 15, 2026
 Time: 6 p.m. ET
 Venue: TD Garden -- Boston, Massachusetts
 Coverage: KFAA, MavsTV, NBCS-BOS, and PCK-BOS
 The Boston Celtics (10-2) are heavily favored (-14.5) to extend a five-game win streak when they host the Dallas Mavericks (7-6) at 6 p.m. ET on Sunday, November 15, 2026 at TD Garden. The game airs on KFAA, MavsTV, NBCS-BOS, and PCK-BOS. The over/under is 219.5 for the matchup.
 Celtics vs. Mavericks Odds & Spread
 All NBA betting lines, odds and prop bets are from FanDuel Sportsbook.
 Favorite Spread Total Favorite Moneyline Underdog Moneyline 
 Celtics -14.5 219.5 -952 +640 
 Celtics vs. Mavericks Prediction & Pick
 All NBA win probability predictions and picks are according to numberFire. 
 Prediction: Celtics win (87.3%)
 Celtics vs. Mavericks Betting Trends
 The Celtics have put together a record of 6-6-0 against the spread this season.
 The Mavericks have seven wins against the spread in 13 games this season.
 Celtics games have gone over the total five times out of 13 chances this season.
 Mavericks games this year have gone over the point total 38.5% of the time (five out of 13 games with a set point total).
 Boston has covered the spread in a lower percentage of its home games than road games. It has covered two times in five games when playing at home, and it has covered four times in seven games when playing on the road.
 The Celtics have gone over the total more often when playing at home, hitting the over in three of five home matchups (60%). In road games, they have hit the over in two of seven games (28.6%).
 Against the spread, Dallas has been better at home (4-3-0) than away (3-3-0).
 In terms of the over/under, Mavericks games have gone over two of seven times at home (28.6%), and three of six on the road (50%).
 Celtics Leaders
 Jayson Tatum is averaging 26.3 points, 6.1 boards and 7.5 assists. At the other end, he averages 0.6 steals and 0.8 blocked shots.
 Paul George averages 22 points, 5.2 boards and 3.8 assists.
 Derrick White is averaging 12.8 points, 2.9 rebounds and 5.3 assists. At the other end, he averages 1.3 steals and 0.8 blocked shots.
 Payton Pritchard is averaging 13.3 points, 3.3 rebounds and 3.7 assists. Defensively, he averages 0.7 steals and 0.2 blocked shots.
 Neemias Queta's numbers on the season are 9.2 points, 6.7 boards and 1.8 assists per game, shooting 55.6% from the floor.
 Mavericks Leaders
 Cooper Flagg averages 24.1 points, 7 boards and 6.4 assists. He is also sinking 47.9% of his shots from the floor and 26.8% from beyond the arc, with 1.3 triples per contest.
 The Mavericks are receiving 22.7 points, 3.5 rebounds and 4.4 assists per game from Kyrie Irving.
 P.J. Washington Jr.'s numbers on the season are 13.9 points, 6.9 rebounds and 1.1 assists per contest. He is sinking 41.3% of his shots from the floor and 35.8% from beyond the arc, with an average of 2.2 treys.
 The Mavericks receive 9.2 points per game from Daniel Gafford, plus 5.2 boards and 1.8 assists.
 Zaccharie Risacher averages 8.1 points, 4.8 boards and 1.4 assists. He is making 42.4% of his shots from the field and 29.8% from 3-point range, with 1.1 treys per game.
